characters.name: Коля
facts: A young man from the present day visiting the future.
Wears a costume for a masquerade.
Has a father in the hospital.
knowledge: Familiar with modern clothing and technology.
Unaware of the future's customs and technology.
goals: Understand the customs of the future.
relationships: Meets an elderly man from the future.
evidence: Коля обрадовался. Он сказал вслух: — Ну, дела!

characters.name: Павел
appearance: Wears green form-fitting clothing and red slippers with long, pointed toes.
Has white hair styled like a hedgehog and long, spread-out mustache.
knowledge: Familiar with past clothing and customs.
Understands the concept of a masquerade.
goals: Guide and educate Kolya about the past.
evidence: Проводи меня немного, мне скучно ехать одному.

locations.name: Moscow, 2082
facts: The city has high, modern buildings with few windows and angular designs.
The Institute of Time is located in the city.
The city has advanced technology and customs.
evidence: Дом был высокий, этажей в двадцать.
Над стеклянной стеной, сквозь которую Коля только что прошёл, по стеклу были выложены громадные золотые буквы: ИНСТИТУТ ВРЕМЕНИ.

objects.name: Unicycle
evidence: Старик ехал на одноколесном велосипеде, расставив руки для равновесия, будто цирковой акробат.

events.event: Kolya meets an elderly man from the future.
causes: Kolya's exploration of the future city.
consequences: Kolya learns about past customs and clothing.
evidence: Проводи меня немного, мне скучно ехать одному.

world_rules.rule: People from the future can visit the present day.

unresolved.question: How does Kolya return to his own time?
